ex.en: Her approach differs from the orthodox view of language teaching.
ex.zh: 她的方法不同于语言教学的传统观点。

words.note: 反义为 unorthodox；常修饰 view、method 等词。

ex.en: She soon became accustomed to the cold winters in the north.
ex.zh: 她很快适应了北方寒冷的冬天。

words.note: be accustomed to 后接名词或动名词；与 used to 结构相近。

ex.en: The dish is a combination of sweet and sour flavors.
ex.zh: 这道菜是酸甜口味的结合。

words.note: 常与 of 连用；in combination with 表「与…配合」。

ex.en: Students must obtain permission before using the laboratory equipment.
ex.zh: 学生使用实验室设备前必须获得许可。

words.note: obtain 比 get 正式，多用于信息、许可、学位等。

ex.en: He was respected as a great statesman who kept his promises.
ex.zh: 他作为信守承诺的伟大政治家而受人尊敬。

words.note: statesman 含敬意，politician 常带贬义，注意褒贬色彩。

ex.en: When sales fell, the company changed tack and targeted younger buyers.
ex.zh: 销量下滑后，公司改变策略，把目标转向年轻买家。

words.note: change tack 原为航海术语，指转舵换向，引申为改变方针。

ex.en: The country's gross domestic product grew by three percent last year.
ex.zh: 该国国内生产总值去年增长了百分之三。

words.note: gross 表「总的、毛的」，net 是「净的」；也指粗俗的。

ex.en: We waited in the departure lounge for nearly three hours.
ex.zh: 我们在候机室等了将近三个小时。

words.note: lounge 作名词指机场、酒店的休息厅；lounge around 指闲混。

ex.en: They sat on the porch and watched the children play in the yard.
ex.zh: 他们坐在门廊上，看着孩子们在院子里玩。

words.note: porch 指房屋入口带顶的门廊；美式常用 front porch。

ex.en: She attended a two-day workshop on how to write a research proposal.
ex.zh: 她参加了一个为期两天的研讨班，学习如何撰写研究计划。

words.note: workshop 除「车间」外，常指短期专题研讨班。

ex.en: Please save the file in a digital format that everyone can open.
ex.zh: 请把文件保存成所有人都能打开的电子格式。

words.note: format 可指版式或数据格式，动词表「格式化」。

ex.en: Many parents make sacrifices so that their children can study abroad.
ex.zh: 许多父母为了让孩子出国留学而做出牺牲。

words.note: make sacrifices for 表为…做出牺牲；也可指祭品。

ex.en: It is illegal to park your car on this side of the street.
ex.zh: 把车停在街道这一侧是违法的。

words.note: il- 为 in- 的变体表否定；反义词 legal。

ex.en: The press corps followed the president throughout the tour.
ex.zh: 记者团在整个访问期间跟随总统。

words.note: corps 单复数同形，词尾 s 不发音，指部队或团体。

ex.en: Thousands gathered on the hill to watch the solar eclipse.
ex.zh: 数千人聚集在山上观看日食。

words.note: solar eclipse 为日食，lunar eclipse 为月食；也指使失色。

ex.en: You should write a formal letter when applying for the position.
ex.zh: 申请这个职位时你应写一封正式信函。

words.note: formal 反义为 informal；formal dress 指礼服。

ex.en: Researchers found that income does not always correlate with happiness.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现，收入与幸福感并不总是相关。

words.note: correlate 常与 with 连用；名词形式为 correlation。

ex.en: House prices in the city have soared over the past five years.
ex.zh: 过去五年里，这座城市的房价飞涨。

words.note: soar 多指价格、气温急速上升；与 sore（疼痛）勿混。

ex.en: He commutes to work by train, which takes about an hour.
ex.zh: 他乘火车通勤上班，大约要一小时。

words.note: commute 指上下班往返；commuter 指通勤者。

ex.en: The economy needs new industries to sustain long-term growth.
ex.zh: 经济需要新产业来维持长期增长。

words.note: sustain 表「维持」也表「遭受（伤害）」。

ex.en: The next few weeks will be critical to the success of the plan.
ex.zh: 接下来几周对该计划的成功至关重要。

words.note: be critical of 表「批评」；critical 也表「至关重要的」。

ex.en: A young guide shepherded the visitors through the narrow streets of the old town.
ex.zh: 一位年轻导游带领游客穿过老城的窄街。

words.note: shepherd 作动词指「带领、引导」，含照顾意味。

ex.en: The plan to close the library caused a public outcry.
ex.zh: 关闭图书馆的计划引发了公众的强烈抗议。

words.note: outcry 多与 public 连用，后接 over 或 about。

ex.en: She came back from the trip with a radiant smile on her face.
ex.zh: 旅行归来时，她脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。

words.note: radiant 由 radiate 而来，指发光，也形容人容光焕发。

ex.en: The principal reason for the delay was a shortage of materials.
ex.zh: 延误的主要原因是材料短缺。

words.note: principal 作名词指校长、本金；principle 是原则，勿混。

ex.en: The instructions were exceedingly difficult to follow for a beginner.
ex.zh: 对初学者来说，这些说明极难照做。

words.note: exceedingly 修饰形容词或副词，比 very 更书面。

ex.en: The court decided to uphold the original decision and rejected the appeal.
ex.zh: 法院决定维持原判，驳回了上诉。

words.note: uphold 常用于法律语境：uphold a ruling 维持裁决。

ex.en: The garden is full of exotic plants from South America.
ex.zh: 这座花园里满是来自南美洲的奇异植物。

words.note: exotic 指外来的、有异国风情，常修饰 plant、food。

ex.en: To my great relief, the exam results arrived earlier than expected.
ex.zh: 令我大为宽慰的是，考试成绩比预期更早到达。

words.note: to one's relief 表令某人宽慰的是；relieve 是动词。

ex.en: Consumers threatened to boycott the brand after the scandal.
ex.zh: 丑闻之后，消费者威胁要抵制这个品牌。

words.note: boycott 源自人名，可作名词和动词，常与 call for 连用。
